mentions.name: Vinarium
mentions.description: A personal wine cellar tracker that catalogs the wines in a wine fridge, indicates when to drink them, and suggests pairings for particular dishes.
mentions.source_excerpt: Second, https://vinarium.one/ something I primarily built for myself to keep track of the wines in my wine fridge, when to drink them, and what pairs well with a particular dish.
